display_long_description:
**AstroCubeVR** — immersive 3D exploration of astronomical datacubes, from Immersive Science.

Load FITS datacubes from ALMA and other radio telescopes and navigate through them in true 3D on Meta Quest.

**Interactive measurement**
- Measure distances directly in RA/Dec coordinates
- Real-time coordinate display with velocity at each point
- Automatic frequency-to-velocity conversion via Doppler formula
- Labels render clearly on top of volume data

**Multi-channel spectral lines**
- Load and compare CO, HCN, HNC, and other molecular emissions side by side
- Per-channel WCS from FITS headers
- Velocity-normalized Z-axis aligns Doppler-shifted features across channels

**Native FITS support**
- Load .fits and .fits.gz cubes directly — no conversion needed
- Full WCS header parsing with automatic voxel scaling
- REST frequency detection from headers or ALMA-style filenames
- ZIP support: download from Google Drive, extract and load automatically

**Smart data handling**
- Auto-optimizes oversized datasets to fit device memory
- Gaussian filtering preserves visual detail during optimization
- Progress feedback during loading — no frozen screens
- Desktop version available at immsci.com/volumeVR for full-resolution work

**Collaborate**
- Share a virtual space with colleagues — explore the same datacube together in real time

**Pre-loaded datasets**
- Curated nebula observations ready to explore on launch

Standalone on Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, and Quest Pro.
